title: STARTEX: Water Line, No Drink

fields.location: Ottawa River Regional Medical Center, Toledo, Lucas County, Ohio
fields.load: Normal census: 322 inpatients; 9 dialysis patients scheduled; 6 elective surgeries planned
fields.staffing: Full on-shift staffing across all departments; facilities and IT on-call teams active
fields.narration: STARTEX. This is an exercise. It is 06:15 AM on Saturday, March 14, 2026, at Ottawa River Regional Medical Center. At 06:02, the City of Toledo Department of Public Utilities reported a treatment plant disruption and issued a Do Not Drink advisory for the area, including the hospital. Water pressure remains normal. The Central Plant’s 40,000-gallon potable water storage tank is full. Dialysis operations are scheduled to begin in 45 minutes.

status.name: City Water Supply
status.note: Do Not Drink advisory issued; pressure normal

status.name: Outpatient Dialysis Center
status.note: RO loop failed chloramine test at 06:44; awaiting action

status.name: Generator Systems
status.note: All three generators tested and ready; fuel at 96-hour capacity

status.name: Building Management System
status.note: BMS server ORRMC-BMS01 online; HVAC and pneumatic tubes functional

fields.facilitatorNote: Players begin with a full picture of the baseline. The advisory is real but not yet known to staff. The dialysis RO failure is the first operational sign. No action is required yet—players must assess risk and initiate response.
fields.scenarioTitle: Water Line, No Drink — A Regional Water Advisory That Reaches Dialysis

instructorNote: This is the first full situational awareness. The dialysis team is already compromised; the HCC must be activated before the advisory becomes known to staff. Watch for premature activation of HICS or overreaction to the RO test failure.
